note: Curated from upstream documentation with explicit Hermes support. Eligibility requires more than 50,000 fetched public stars and a reviewed entry in assets/js/github-policy.js. Older ineligible write-ups remain stored but hidden. Examples and summaries are archive-authored; installation commands are documented upstream.

items.title: obra/superpowers
items.summary: Development skills with a native Hermes plugin installer.
cardPoints: Use structured testing, debugging and review skills.
items.detail:
WHAT IT DOES
A development workflow built from reusable skills. The project documents a native Hermes plugin, so its coding practices can be used inside Hermes sessions.

HOW TO USE IT
Install the plugin with the command below, then restart active Hermes sessions. Start with a feature or bug and use the planning, testing and review workflow.

USE CASE
Turn a loosely described feature into an implementation plan, then work through changes and verification. This is an archive-authored example, not a quoted user report.

LIMITATION
The README notes that Hermes has no post-compaction hook for this plugin. Restart the session if skills stop triggering after a long conversation.

items.title: DietrichGebert/ponytail
items.summary: A Hermes plugin for focused implementation, review and technical-debt work.
cardPoints: Run code review and audit commands inside Hermes.
Use explicit modes for debt reduction and focused changes.
items.detail:
WHAT IT DOES
Ponytail documents a Hermes plugin that supplies the active mode before each model turn and exposes its own review, audit and debt commands.

HOW TO USE IT
Install the plugin, restart Hermes, then invoke /ponytail-help to inspect the available commands. /ponytail-review and /ponytail-debt provide starting points for review and cleanup.

USE CASE
Review a working feature for unnecessary code, then identify a small cleanup you can verify independently. This is an archive-authored example.

LIMITATION
The active runtime mode is process-local; do not assume it persists across a Hermes restart.

items.title: pbakaus/impeccable
items.summary: Design guidance and critique skills packaged for Hermes.
cardPoints: Audit a page and turn design feedback into specific changes.
Install the Hermes skill package with the provider selector.
items.detail:
WHAT IT DOES
Impeccable packages design guidance and commands for auditing, critiquing and polishing interfaces. Its README documents a Hermes distribution and command routing through /impeccable.

HOW TO USE IT
Use the installer below for a global Hermes installation, then reload Hermes. For project-local installation instead, the README requires running hermes skills trust from the project root.

USE CASE
Ask Hermes to audit a settings screen, prioritize readability problems, and apply a focused polish pass. This is an archive-authored example.

LIMITATION
The skill works in Hermes, but the project’s automatic design edit hook does not run there.

items.title: HKUDS/CLI-Anything
items.summary: An experimental community Hermes skill for building CLI harnesses around software.
cardPoints: Ask Hermes to build or refine a command-line harness.
Use the documented community Hermes skill installer.
items.detail:
WHAT IT DOES
CLI-Anything documents a community Hermes skill that adapts its harness-building workflow to Hermes tools, including file operations and terminal execution.

HOW TO USE IT
Clone the repository and run its Hermes installer, then restart Hermes. The installer uses the active HERMES_HOME skills directory, falling back to ~/.hermes/skills.

USE CASE
With a local checkout of the target application, ask Hermes to build a CLI harness for that application or refine an existing harness for a specific workflow. This is an archive-authored example.

STATUS
The upstream project labels this Hermes integration experimental and community-maintained.
